en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a rural or small-town scene with a garden restaurant (Garten-Restaurant) and inn. A wooden building with large arched windows and a sign reading "Garten-Restaurant" stands on the left, next to a fenced garden shaded by large trees where people are seated. On the right are low residential-style buildings along a dirt road. The lower margin of the postcard contains printed German text identifying the place and the publisher.
